newsitem.title: UK: Refuge shareholders approve Utd deal.
newsitem.headline: Refuge shareholders approve Utd deal.

text.p: UK life assurer Refuge Group Plc said on Wednesday that shareholders at extraordinary general meetings have approved its merger with rival United Friendly.
The shareholders also approved the issue of a new security, entitling shareholders to receive any extra value in the ordinary branch of Refuge Assurance which might be established in the future.
The proposed 1.46 billion stg merger of the two companies was announced in August.

However, it ran into opposition from some institutional shareholders who protested that during discussions with the UK government Refuge could have unlocked more "orphan" assets for shareholders from its ordinary branch of business.
The orphan assets are those a company holds which are surplus to meeting policyholder requirements.
The new security appeared to allay these fears for the shareholders with large stakes in the company, and fears of a shareholder revolt over the issue have subsided recently.
Refuge added it would make a further announcement in due course. The new company will be called United Assurance Group.
